# TBD Field Manual

The field manual is the single source of truth for how this unit fights. Where a mission briefing contradicts it, the briefing wins for that operation only.

## 1. Chain of command

Platoon staff issue intent, not instructions. Squad leads own execution inside their assigned boundary.

## 2. Movement

- Default formation is a staggered column on roads, wedge in the open.
- Bounding overwatch inside 400 m of a suspected contact.
- Nobody crosses a linear danger area without near-side security set.

## 3. Contact drills

On contact: return fire, take cover, report. In that order. The contact report is `CONTACT — direction — distance — description`.

## 4. Casualties

Stabilise where the casualty falls only if the position is covered. Otherwise drag to cover first. Medics do not move forward of the base of fire.
data.title: Field Manual

data.body_md:
# Radio Procedure

## Nets

| Net | Users | Channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Command | Platoon staff + squad leads | 1 |
| Squad | Inside a squad | 2–5 |
| Air | Rotary + JTAC | 8 |

## Format

Always: `<callsign you want> this is <your callsign>, <message>, over.`

Brevity beats politeness. If the net is busy, wait — do not step on a contact report.
data.title: Radio Procedure

data.body_md:
# Medical SOP

Tourniquet high and tight, then reassess. Morphine only after bleeding is controlled — it masks the shock that tells you the bleeding is not controlled.

Every rifleman carries two tourniquets. One is not for you.
data.title: Medical SOP

data.body_md:
# Server Rules

1. No team-killing. Two warnings then a ban; see the audit log for precedent.
2. Modpack must match the announced version.
3. Zeus is a privilege, not a rank.
data.title: Server Rules
